chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ismail ibn Marrar, from Yunus, from Hisham ibn al-Hakam, from Zurarah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Barni dates satiate, are palatable, and are nourishing; they are the cure and there is no illness for them. They remove fatigue, and with every date is a good deed (reward).

key_terms.التَّمْرُ الْبَرْنِيُّ: Barni dates, a specific variety of dates known for their quality
key_terms.لَا دَاءَ لَهُ: No illness for it, meaning no specific ailment is caused by it

ai.seo_question: What are the health and spiritual benefits of Barni dates according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights the Barni date as a comprehensive remedy (*ad-dawa*) that not only satisfies hunger and enhances flavor but also eliminates fatigue (*al-aya*). The tradition underscores the dual nature of this food source, linking its physical benefits of nourishment and recovery with spiritual merit, as each date consumed carries a good deed. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on the medicinal and spiritual virtues of natural foods prescribed by the Imams.
